diagnosis.what_happened: Stale validation reports were left on disk after graduation, causing continuous validation hook failures.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failure to physically decontaminate legacy validation reports caused recursive validation hooks to detect stale errors and block progress.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Legacy validation reports should have been renamed to .stale.json or the directory removed during the graduation process.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Physical decontamination prevents stale states from triggering recursive pipeline blocks, ensuring accurate state evaluation.

desired_behavior: Always execute physical disk decontamination during learning graduation by renaming legacy validation reports to .stale.json or deleting them.
generalization: Never leave stale validation state files on disk; always proactively de-index them to prevent false validation failures.

evidence.observed_value: Validation block due to stale legacy_validation/validation_report.json.
evidence.threshold_value: Zero stale validation reports in active delivery directories.
